# Pushover: integration analysis

> Generated by API Integration Scout from <https://pushover.net/api> on 2026-10-07T08:35:54.983Z.
> Every finding is marked **Documented** (quoted from the docs and verified), **Inferred** (the agent's reasoning) or **Not found in docs**.

Pushover is a REST API for sending push notifications to users' devices. You register an application to get a token, then POST messages to a user or group key. It also offers receipts and callbacks for emergency-priority messages, plus subscription, groups, glances, teams, licensing and open-client APIs.

## At a glance

| Area | Finding | Status | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Base URL | https://api.pushover.net/1 | Documented | [/api](https://pushover.net/api) |
| Authentication | api_key: Application API token sent as the 'token' body parameter, together with a 'user' key (user or group) on message requests. | Documented | [/api](https://pushover.net/api) |
| Pagination | — | Not found in docs | — |
| Rate limits | — | Not found in docs | — |
| Webhooks | Yes: emergency notification acknowledged | Documented | [/api/receipts](https://pushover.net/api/receipts) |
| Error format | — | Not found in docs | — |
| Versioning | url_path (1) | Documented | [/api](https://pushover.net/api) |
| Endpoints | 4 found | 4 documented, 0 inferred | — |

## Risks

- **MEDIUM**: Rate limits not read. The 'Limitations' and 'Being Friendly' sections were in the truncated part of the page. Limits are unconfirmed.
- **MEDIUM**: Callbacks unsigned. No signature verification was seen for callback POSTs, so the endpoint should be protected some other way.
- **LOW**: Secrets in query string. Receipt polling puts the app token in the URL query, where it can end up in logs.
- **LOW**: Deprecation. The site announces that the GitHub notification endpoint is being deprecated in favor of webhooks.

## Open questions

- What are the message size limits and monthly message quotas per app?
- What is the error response format and which status codes are used?
- Are callbacks signed or sent from fixed IPs?
- Do the Glances, Groups and Subscription APIs use the same token auth?
